content.text: 2022 has 11 federal holidays under 5 U.S.C. 6103. Observed on a different day: New Year's Day 2022-01-01 -> 2021-12-31; Juneteenth National Independence Day 2022-06-19 -> 2022-06-20; Christmas Day 2022-12-25 -> 2022-12-26. Federal Reserve differs: New Year's Day Fed open (Saturday holiday).
